sourceText:
Crusted Salmon
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 10:29pm

Ingredients




cup Mayonnaise
1 tablespoon Lemon juice
1 Garlic clove, minced
1 teaspoon Dried dillweed
teaspoon Salt
teaspoon Black pepper
4 Salmon steaks or fillets, (6 to 8 ounces each)

Preparation

1 Spray the cold grill racks with nonstick cooking spray. Preheat the grill to medium heat. In a small bowl, combine all the ingredients except the salmon; mix well. Rinse the salmon with cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Spread the mixture over both sides of the salmon, dividing it evenly. Grill the salmon for 10 to 12 minutes, or until the fish flakes easily with a fork and is cooked through in the center. Serve immediately. 2 NOTE: If you have a hinged grill basket, use it for the salmon. It's really the best way to grill fish.
